title: Signal: Requirement that pulls a non-runtime extra
scope: A requirements.txt file that declares an extra that installs development or test dependencies at runtime.
limitations: It matches an extra that installs development or test dependencies at runtime in the parsed requirements.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A requirements.txt that mentions an extra that installs development or test dependencies at runtime in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
